evals.prompt: $pr-canvas Generate an interactive HTML PR review walkthrough for PR #42 using the skill's template, CSS, and diff renderer.
evals.expected_output: Fetches PR metadata, files, and comments via `gh api`, writes structured body HTML with core vs collapsed boilerplate sections and `data-diff` placeholders, safely escapes JSON patches (`\u003c` for `</script>`), injects `assets/styles.css` and `assets/renderer.js` into `assets/template.html`, and serves it locally.
expectations: Fetches PR metadata, file patches, and comments using `gh api`.
Categorizes changed files into expanded core cards and collapsed mechanical/boilerplate sections.
Uses `assets/styles.css`, `assets/renderer.js`, and `assets/template.html` from the skill directory.
Escapes `<`, `>`, and `&` when injecting patch JSON so literal `</script>` in diffs cannot break HTML parsing.

evals.prompt: $pr-canvas Build a visual HTML walkthrough for PR #108 and include a plain-English pseudocode summary above the 180-line retry client diff.
evals.expected_output: Includes a `.file-note` plain-English pseudocode summary for the complex file with the full diff inside a collapsible `.bp-section` using `data-diff`.
expectations: Adds a plain-English or pseudocode summary in `.file-note` for the verbose algorithm.
Places the raw diff inside a collapsible `.bp-section` card with a `data-diff` placeholder.
Uses a fixed local port (`127.0.0.1:8432`) when serving `/tmp/pr-review-108.html`.

evals.prompt: $pr-canvas Assemble the HTML review page for a PR whose test patch contains a literal `</script>` string.
evals.expected_output: Saves patches via `jq` and uses Python to replace `<`, `>`, and `&` with Unicode escapes before injecting into `assets/template.html` so the page renders safely.
expectations: Never pastes raw patch strings directly into an inline `<script>` tag.
Escapes `<` to `\u003c`, `>` to `\u003e`, and `&` to `\u0026` during assembly.
Writes the assembled standalone HTML file to `/tmp/pr-review-{number}.html`.
